jobs.prompt:
Third Opus security review of the orchestrator-mode guard: FAIL. The allowlist parser keeps growing new bypasses, so this round SHRINK it: anything not simple, remove rather than parse. Fix every finding, add a test per finding in tests/orchestrator-mode-review4.test.mjs, keep all existing guard tests passing, never weaken a deny.
1 HIGH sed: operands that look like substitutions are skipped (omSedReadOnly, omFilterOperandsOk) and the long expression and file options with an equals sign are not caught. Remove sed from the allowlist except the exact form sed -n 'N,Mp' FILE (first non-option operand is the only script and must be an exact line-print), refuse -e -f the long forms of the expression and file options -i in every spelling, check every other operand as a file to read.
2 HIGH node: omNodeRunsInstallSwarm/omSwarmInvocation accept any node option before the script (preload, eval). Allow no node options before the script and require the node binary to equal process.execPath or an absolute path recorded for the install.
3 HIGH redirects: omRedirectsForbidden/omPlainWords list only some operators; bare >&, <>, &>> may be kept as arguments. Refuse every token containing < or > or & except the exact harmless forms (2>&1 and 2>/dev/null), after the tokenizer splits.
4 HIGH env switch: guardDecision turns orchestrator mode on only when CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is set and exists. Use the resolved project root and orchestratorModeEnabled alone; a missing or wrong variable must fall back to a cwd walk-up and stay ON; use enforceOrchestratorMode computed in runGuardDecisionForHook.
5 MEDIUM the parent hook stops at the handbuild off-file before checking orchestrator mode: still run the orchestrator check.
6 MEDIUM bad JSON or a non-object input is let through with no CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR: deny whenever the input is non-empty and cannot be decided (or derive root from cwd and deny in a swarm project).
7 MEDIUM the hook now checks only Bash, Edit, Write and NotebookEdit: build the checked set from WRITE_TOOLS plus Bash.
8 MEDIUM jq filters are never checked (env, input_filename, $ENV, getpath builtins can print secrets): allow jq only with a simple field-path filter (dots, brackets, pipes of fields), refuse every builtin and $.
9 MEDIUM find after a pipe and wc skip the operand check: run omFilterOperandsOk on both.
10 MEDIUM swarm: the --root value is never checked (must resolve to the project root); run and integrate accept any flag with any = value (allow only a fixed list of flags); decide must be limited to read-only verbs.
11 MEDIUM worker exemption needs only SWARM_WORKER_RUN_ID naming any run with a record: require the run id, the session's workspace path and a live run state to match (use isVerifiedSwarmWorkerCwd).
12 LOW orchestratorModeProtectedWriteRel resolves only the immediate parent: resolve the deepest existing ancestor then re-append the rest.
13 LOW a hand-build approval naming files skips the allowlist: still run the allowlist and refuse commands not on it.
14 LOW the test marker is a fixed public string and the scratch-exempt environment variable turns the mode off for projects under the scratch folder: remove the scratch exemption from shipped code and give the tests a different way (fixtures that create the real condition); gate the hook test-fault environment variable the same way.
15 LOW compare git, gh, vercel and node against fixed absolute paths found once at hook start from a fixed trusted PATH, not the session PATH; refuse a relative cd when CDPATH is set.
16 Verify tools/orchestrator-hook.mjs imports child_process, fs and hookScriptPath where used.
